name: Meridian rebuilt
premise: The incumbent, rebuilt on the same engine so the comparison is like-for-like rather than a straw man. Chromatic ground, one hue with two tuned values as the signature -- the structure the current kit already committed to. Its job is to give the owner a real defence of the current brand, not a token 'keep what you have' option.

ground.label: Meridian
ground.note: The deep sky before dawn. Unchanged from the shipping kit.

accent_light.label: Daybreak (light)
accent_light.note: The deep tuned value of the one-hue-two-values signature, for light grounds.

accent_dark.label: Daybreak (dark)
accent_dark.note: The pale tuned value of the same signature hue, for dark grounds.
